name: Stasis Keeper
displayText: Units blocked by this Unit do not Ready during their controller's next Ready Step.

notes: The lock is fixed onto the attacker the moment blockers are declared, so this Unit dying in that same combat does not undo it.
It stops only the Ready Step. An effect that says "Ready target Unit" still readies the attacker.
An attacker that leaves the battlefield before that Ready Step loses the lock along with everything else it was carrying.
